expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.N===0 && S.kohde===1 && S.ilmaisu===1 && S.virhe===-1 && S.running===0 ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const R=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]')]; return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='0' && R[0].max==='2000' && R[0].step==='10' ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===3 && L[0]==='1,2,0' && L[1]==='1,0' && L[2]==='2,10,50' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: patient (one tumour · two tumours · none), detection (coincidence · single photons), speed 2 · 10 · 50 per s

expr: (() => { const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root .controls'); return k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') && c.firstElementChild.tagName==='BUTTON' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: DOM order canvas, controls (main button first), readout
